messages:
Nina (AE): Tessera Health confirmed a 2-node private POC next Wed. They want a short install validation + automatic fallback to hosted inference. Need a preflight checklist we can send their infra/security teams.
Omar (SE): I'll draft the checklist. Quick: will they let us create the operator SA or provide a kubeconfig?
Nina (AE): They said they prefer to create creds but are open if we need to bootstrap.
Gabi (Field Eng): Hardware/drivers: require Linux kernel >=5.15, NVIDIA driver >=525.x for H100/A100. Recommend CUDA >=12.1. Ask for `nvidia-smi -L` output and driver full details.
Tao (Security): Security constraints: no long-lived kubeconfigs. If they hand us a kubeconfig it must be time-limited (24h) and IP-restricted. Otherwise they create a namespaced service account and supply the token + RBAC YAML. No cluster-admin. Also request cert/key custody notes and whether keys live in an HSM/KMS.
Kai (SRE): Network preflight: allow outbound to registry.redwood.ai:443, DNS (udp/53), NTP (udp/123), and outbound to our fallback hostnames on 443. If airgapped, we need image tarballs and an import manifest. Ensure MTU >=1400.
Gabi (Field Eng): Add verification snippets for them to run and paste back (copypasteable):
```
# worker node
nvidia-smi -L
nvidia-smi -q | head -n 50
uname -r
cat /etc/os-release
# control plane
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl version --short
dmesg | tail -n 200
```
Omar (SE): I'll include a minimal RBAC they can apply if they create the SA. I'll also include an airgap import step with `ctr`/`docker load` example.
Tao (Security): Also ask about private DNS (split-horizon) and if pulls must go via an internal proxy. Need a short statement on patch cadence and cert rotation.
Gabi (Field Eng): Optional stress check: run our tiny two-worker test container to exercise CUDA allocations and watch for driver errors. We'll give them the container command in the playbook.
ops-bot: api-key:create requested by Omar (SE) -> created key tessera-poc-fallback (inference-only) expires=14d
Nina (AE): I'll send the one-pager with checklist + commands + RBAC and schedule a 45m kickoff. Who can join?
Kai (SRE): I can do first 20m for network/airgap questions.
Gabi (Field Eng): I'll take the rest for driver validation and stress checks.
Tao (Security): I'll join to confirm RBAC and KMS expectations.
Omar (SE): I'll run the operator bootstrap during the call.
Nina (AE): Thanks. I'll circulate the checklist and ask them to return the outputs by EOD tomorrow. :mailbox_with_mail:
